listings.name: Harborview Accessible Hotel
listings.summary: Downtown hotel with verified roll-in shower rooms, 36-inch doorways, and a staffed accessibility desk at check-in.
listings.description: Harborview offers dedicated accessible king rooms with roll-in showers, grab bars, lowered closet rods, and a 36-inch clear doorway. The lobby is step-free from the sidewalk, and the accessibility desk can arrange a shower chair or visual-alert kit before you arrive.

listings.name: Lincoln Park Inclusive Stay
listings.address: 2140 N Lincoln Park West, Chicago, IL 60614
listings.summary: Ground-floor stay with ramp entry and a wide hallway. Roll-in shower reported by 12 community reviewers.
listings.description: A garden-level apartment with a portable ramp at the side door, 34-inch interior doors, and a roll-in shower with a fold-down bench. Street parking includes a nearby van-accessible space; the host texts the curb cut map before check-in.

listings.name: SFO Accessibility Services Hub
listings.address: San Francisco International Airport, San Francisco, CA 94128
listings.summary: Terminal accessibility desk, elevator maps, and wheelchair assistance between gates.
listings.description: SFO’s accessibility services desks in Terminals 1–3 coordinate wheelchair assistance, companion restrooms, and elevator-only routes. Service animals are welcome; request help 48 hours ahead through your airline for the smoothest connection.

listings.name: Ocean Breeze Accessible Resort
listings.summary: Beachfront property with a pool lift, accessible paths, and multiple roll-in shower suites.
listings.description: Ocean Breeze keeps several roll-in shower suites on the second floor (elevator from the lobby). Pool and beach paths are packed-and-firm, with a pool lift reserved by room number. Valet can stage a van-accessible space under the porte-cochère.

listings.name: Sunshine Family Suites Orlando
listings.summary: Theme-park area hotel popular with families — roll-in showers, a pool ramp, and wide suite doorways.
listings.description: Two-room suites with roll-in showers, 36-inch doors, and a connecting door that also clears 32 inches. The leisure pool has a sloped entry; the splash pad is step-free. Shuttle to parks is a low-floor coach if you book 24 hours ahead.

listings.name: Brooklyn Heights Accessible Loft
listings.summary: Elevator building with a 34-inch doorway and a tub transfer bench on request — no roll-in shower.
listings.description: A fourth-floor loft in an elevator building. The bathroom is a standard tub/shower with a portable transfer bench and grab bars. Doorways measure 34 inches; there is no dedicated accessible parking, so plan for street drop-off on Pierrepont.

listings.name: MCO Terminal B Mobility Center
listings.summary: Orlando International — wheelchair service, accessible restrooms, and elevator access to all concourses.
listings.description: The Terminal B mobility center coordinates wheelchair assistance, companion care restrooms, and elevator-only routes to airside gates. Accessible parking is in the Terminal B garage on levels 2–4, marked with van-accessible aisles.

listings.name: Mission Bay Step-Free Suites
listings.summary: Modern suites with roll-in showers, lowered closet rods, and a garage with van-accessible stalls.
listings.description: Mission Bay rooms include roll-in showers with handheld wands, 36-inch doors, and lowered thermostats. The garage has two van-accessible stalls next to the elevator lobby. Service animals stay without a fee; staff can store a spare cushion overnight.

listings.name: Wicker Park Ground Floor
listings.summary: Step-free storefront stay with a wide bathroom and lowered sink — tub shower, not roll-in.
listings.description: A converted storefront with a zero-step entry from the sidewalk. The bathroom has a 33-inch door, grab bars, and a lowered sink, but the shower is a low-threshold tub. Best if you transfer rather than roll in. Permit parking is a block north.

listings.name: Miami Beach WAV Connect
listings.summary: Rear-entry wheelchair vans with tie-downs, lowered floor, and drivers trained for hotel curb pickup.
listings.description: Side- and rear-entry vans with Q'Straint tie-downs, a 32-inch ramp, and a lowered floor. Drivers wait at hotel porte-cochères and MIA arrivals. Book a window for cruise ports. Service animals ride in the cabin; no extra fee.

listings.name: JFK Terminal 4 Mobility Desk
listings.summary: Wheelchair assistance, companion restrooms, and elevator maps for Terminal 4 connections.
listings.description: The Terminal 4 mobility desk sits after security near the food hall. Staff can escort to gates, arrange a passenger-assist chair, and mark elevator-only routes to the AirTrain. Accessible parking is in the Terminal 4 garage, level 2.

listings.name: Pearl District Accessible Inn
listings.summary: Boutique inn with roll-in showers, a quiet elevator, and street-level van drop-off.
listings.description: Four designated accessible rooms with roll-in showers, handheld sprays, and lowered closet rods. The 9th Avenue curb has a van-height drop-off; the garage stall is standard accessible, not van-length. Streetcar stop is two blocks on a curb-cut route.

listings.name: South Congress Garden Stay
listings.summary: Casita with a ramp from the driveway, wide doors, and a roll-in shower added in 2024.
listings.description: A backyard casita with a timber ramp (1:12), 36-inch doors, and a new roll-in shower with a fold-down seat. Driveway parking is level and wide enough for a side-entry van. No elevator — everything is on one floor.

listings.name: SEA Airport Mobility Hub
listings.summary: Sea-Tac wheelchair assistance, companion restrooms, and elevator access across concourses.
listings.description: The mobility hub near Door 26 coordinates wheelchair assistance and companion restrooms. The A–D concourses are elevator-connected; the train to the rental car facility has level boarding. Service animals are welcome throughout the terminal.

listings.name: Capitol Hill Step-Free Loft
listings.summary: Elevator loft with wide doors and an accessible restroom — tub shower, request a bench.
listings.description: A third-floor loft via a modern elevator. Doorways are 33 inches. The bathroom has grab bars and a tub; hosts keep a transfer bench in the closet. No dedicated parking — rideshare drop-off on Pike is the usual plan.

listings.name: Austin WAV Collective
listings.summary: Downtown wheelchair vans with rear ramps, airport runs, and hotel-to-venue transfers.
listings.description: A small fleet of rear-entry WAVs with 1,000-lb winch option, four-point tie-downs, and drivers who will wait at AUS arrivals. Book same-day if a van is free; festival weeks fill up. Service animals welcome.
